title: Phase 6 process contract and close-readiness DTO boundary cleanup
summary: Migrates process active-job/control-flag contract imports and CloseReadinessDto imports from desktop compatibility exports to existing core owners, leaving schedule-stop watcher lifecycle edges open.
reason: Phase 6 boundary cleanup is reducing process-domain core-to-desktop imports in contract/DTO-only slices while deferring lifecycle-sensitive schedule-stop watcher movement to a separate plan.
behavior_before: Process active-job/control-flag modules imported contracts and schema constants through desktop contracts, and guard facade imported CloseReadinessDto through desktop dto_status, producing seven allowlisted NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP findings across five import-statement groups.
behavior_after: Process modules import the same contracts/schema constants from mediapipeline.core.kernel.contracts and CloseReadinessDto from mediapipeline.core.kernel.dto_status while desktop compatibility exports remain in place; the process schedule-stop watcher allowlist rows remain open.
manual_validation: PASS: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.check_dependency_boundaries --format json --report-only (hard_findings=32, allowlisted=32, unallowlisted=0, unused_allowlist=0, NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP=15; domains: config=8, processes=2, queue=4, schedule=1)
rollback_plan: Restore process active-job/control-flag imports to the desktop compatibility modules, restore guard facade CloseReadinessDto import to desktop dto_status, restore the five removed allowlist rows, refresh the four generated summaries, and mark AB-PROC-002, AB-PROC-008, AB-PROC-009, AB-PROC-012, and AB-PROC-013 open again in the edge ledger.
notes:
Import ownership change only.
